help_faq_a2: Reference audio supports WAV, MP3, FLAC, and OGG formats.
help_faq_a3: Use high-quality reference audio (clear voice, no noise), 5-30 seconds in length.
help_faq_a4: VoxCPM2 is suitable for general voice synthesis and cloning. IndexTTS 2.5 is ideal for scenarios requiring emotion control and precise duration control.
